test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word: He was the __**last **__person to finish the race.

options.text: The last song on the album was his favorite.
The meeting will last for an hour.
This is the last slice of pizza.
We were the last to reach the venue.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"last"** in the sentence refers to the most recent or final occurrence of something. (अंतिम, पिछला)
 
 
• **Example:** The last person to leave the room forgot to switch off the lights.
 
 
 
 
• In Option 2, the word **"last"** serves as a homonym because it takes on a different meaning: to continue or endure for a period of time. (टिकना, जारी रहना)
 
 
• **Example:** The battery will last for five hours.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The last song on the album was his favorite. (अंतिम गाना) 

 This refers to the final or most recent item in a sequence (the song), similar to the original sentence but does not serve as a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** She saved the last piece of cake for herself.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** This is the last slice of pizza. (अंतिम टुकड़ा) 

 Similar to the original sentence, it refers to the final or remaining portion, not a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** The last slice was too delicious to share.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** We were the last to reach the venue. (अंतिम व्यक्ति) 

 This refers to being the final or most delayed to do something, again not a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** They were the last to arrive at the party.
 
 

39:T923,

The correct answer is **Option 2**.
